clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in northern Ashenvale, Ruul Snowhoof waits for rescue. The tauren druid is trapped in bear form inside a crude cage at Thistlefur Hold, relying on Horde adventurers to free him and guide him to safety.

Ruul Snowhoof entered northern Ashenvale and fell into the hands of the corrupt Thistlefur furbolgs. He took the shape of a bear, and his captors mistook him for a wild beast. They locked him in a wooden cage deep within Thistlefur Hold instead of killing him. Now weakened and unable to safely leave his form or fight his way out alone, Ruul waits for Horde allies to open the cage, drive off his captors, and clear a path through the den. He hopes to return to his sister, Yama Snowhoof, at Splintertree Post.
